subject.title: feat(workshop): allow restoring rejected proposals back to pending

question: Should restoring rejected Skill Workshop proposals become a supported core lifecycle operation across service, Gateway, CLI, and Control UI?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing lifecycle/API surface, and the evidence shows no maintainer approval yet; the current patch also needs a concrete registry fix and proof before it could merge.

options.title: Sponsor restore in core
options.body: Accept the product direction, then require the registry/scope/test/proof fixes before merge.

options.title: Narrow or defer
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a smaller proposal, such as CLI-only restore or a different audit/history design.

options.title: Decline the lifecycle
options.body: Close the feature direction if rejected proposals should intentionally remain terminal workshop history.

recommendation.title: Sponsor restore in core
recommendation.body: Accept the product direction, then require the registry/scope/test/proof fixes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Skill Workshop lifecycle and proposal Gateway surface were introduced in their recent feature commit.
